# Digital Ninja Technologies

> Global Design & Software Development Agency. We build Websites, Mobile Apps, Software and Games for startups, SMEs and enterprises worldwide.

Digital Ninja Technologies is a global design and software development agency helping founders, startups, and businesses build high-quality digital products. We combine strategic design thinking with modern engineering to ship products that convert, scale, and last.

**Website:** https://www.thedigitalninjatech.com
**Contact:** thedigitalninjatechnologies@gmail.com
**Booking:** https://www.thedigitalninjatech.com/booking
**Studio:** https://www.thedigitalninjatech.com/studio

## What We Do

- **Web Design & Development** — Conversion-focused websites, landing pages, web apps, and full-scale platforms built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind
- **Mobile App Development** — Cross-platform iOS and Android apps built with Flutter. Fast, polished, and production-ready
- **Custom Software Development** — Scalable backend systems, SaaS platforms, dashboards, and internal tools
- **Brand Identity** — Logo design, visual identity systems, colour, typography, and brand guidelines
- **UI/UX Design** — User research, wireframes, prototypes, and interface design for web and mobile
- **MVP Development** — Fastest path from validated idea to live product for early-stage startups
- **Game UI & Development** — Cross-platform games with immersive interfaces built with Unity and WebGL

## Selected Portfolio

- **Veritas** — Waitlist website and mobile app design for a cross-border escrow payment platform. Built for freelancers doing borderless work. Live: https://www.useveritasapp.com
- **Brandface** — Lead conversion landing page for a legal marketing agency. Live: https://brandface-eta.vercel.app
- **Moducode** — UI/UX design for a B2B SaaS talent platform connecting global companies with engineers from emerging markets. Live: https://krevops.com
- **Korlod Works** — Full website design and development for a creative agency covering brand identity, web solutions, and content marketing. Live: https://korlodworks.com
